head_commit.message:
Repin the hosted workflow digest after the docs install step

The docs lane grew an `npm ci` step, which changed ci.yml, and the meta
lane correctly refused with CI_META_FAILED: hosted workflow source digest
drifted. Recomputed against the committed workflow; `node ops/ci/meta.mjs`
passes.

The repin itself is another agent's, made while I was reading the failure.
I caused the drift, so I am landing it rather than leaving the lane red.

workflow_runs.display_title: Capture the Control Tower against a real ledger

head_commit.message:
Capture the Control Tower against a real ledger

Walks every surface against a running bullet-farmd, exchanging the
one-time bootstrap token in the page's own origin so the session cookie is
set by the daemon rather than forged. No fixtures and no mocked responses.

Chromium renders with LCD text and subpixel positioning off, which cuts a
capture from about 11,000 distinct colours to about 2,000 without
softening the glyphs, so the frames survive an 8-bit palette with a
deviation small enough to state precisely.

head_commit.message:
Install actionlint directly and pin an install-action that has the rest

The first GitHub Actions run this repository has ever had failed the lint
and security lanes with

    install-action does not support actionlint@1.7.8

taiki-e/install-action has no actionlint manifest at any version, so that
step could never have succeeded. actionlint is now installed the same way
gitleaks already is, from its own release, pinned by version and sha256,
reusing the script bullet-git already carries.

The remaining tools do exist in the action, just not in the pinned
v2.62.45 manifest, so that pin moves to v2.87.9. Requested tool versions
are unchanged.
